Name: Capitalist Dream Farm
Author: DaisyNiko
Description:
[b]♡ features ♡[/b]

[list]
[*]replaces Standard farm
[*]tonnes of berry bushes
[*]grass is tillable
[*]two different warps for fast travel
[*]invisible barriers in pens that animals can't pass
[*]multiple configurable versions
[*]compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded
[/list]

[b]config options[/b]
(see screenshots to decide which one you want)

"version": "decorated" or "clean" (default decorated)
"gameplay": "singleplayer" or "multiplayer" (default singleplayer)


[b]installation[/b]

1. install SMAPI and Content Patcher then download this mod
2. extract [CP] Capitalist Dream Farm folder to Stardew Valley/Mods
3. run the game with SMAPI and start a new save on the Standard farm
